blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has launched a probe into a data security incident that it detected on its platforms on Nov. 6 and that may have compromised individual profile details. On Monday, the commission confirmed in a statement reports of a data breach affecting its user accounts. READ: Data breach costs jump in SE Asia “The categories of personal data that may have been exposed include individual profile information. The Commission is currently verifying the origin, scope, and validity of these affected records,” it said. Based on a letter to affected users, the SEC said the exposed […]...
